title: This platform gives you ChatGPT, Claude, and more for life for a one-time fee, only $55.30
content_html:
TL;DR: ChatPlayground AI gives you access to 20+ major AI tools, and it’s only $55.30 through Sept. 10.

Credit: ChatPlayground AI

$55.30
$619 Save $563.70

Pretty much anyone who uses AI every day tends to keep two or three chatbots open at once, because no single AI model is great at every single task. Testing the same prompt in ChatGPT, then Claude, then Gemini to find the strongest answer eats up more time than most people admit, and you’re also burning through tokens that whole time. If you want a simpler solution, ChatPlayground is a new platform that gives you lifetime access to dozens of the most popular models, and you can use them all in the same window. Right now, lifetime access is just $55.30 (reg. $619).

One platform for all your AI tools

Type a prompt once, and ChatPlayground AI runs it across every model you’ve selected, then lines up the responses so you can compare them at a glance. That roster includes GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet, Gemini, DeepSeek, Llama, and Perplexity, with more added as new models come out.

Beyond comparisons, ChatPlayground AI includes prompt engineering tools to refine outputs, image and PDF chat for context-aware responses, saved chat history for ongoing projects, and AI image generation powered by leading models. There’s even a Chrome extension to integrate it directly into your browsing workflow.

The Unlimited Plan means unlimited messages per month, making it ideal for startups, product teams, marketers, and prompt engineers who run experiments nonstop. You also get priority support and early access to new features and future models.

If you’re already paying for multiple AI tools — or constantly switching between them — this consolidates everything into one streamlined platform.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Through Sept. 10 at 11:59 p.m. PT, it’s only $55.30 to get a ChatPlayground AI lifetime subscription.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
